summary: ResQ migration now builds Generated dataset types with the data-engine instead of copying ResQ values.
details: For a dataset type flagged Generated=true whose instance name equals its type, the migration calls the data-engine in-process to produce the dataset CSV, preserving the ResQ origin/development (triangle) and period (vector) lengths.
Generated datasets are written as live engine caches (source_kind=engine with authoritative processing provenance) so the app treats them as fresh rather than stale imported snapshots.
DFM, Result Selection, Bornhuetter Ferguson, manual, and non-generated calculated datasets continue to import from ResQ.
If the data-engine cannot generate a dataset, the migration records an error for that dataset instead of falling back to ResQ values.
